reviews.title: Glitches
reviews.text: The app was working fine for a long periodic time and did well with keeping track of my progress and giving me new exercises and things to do . But now I’m on the second day of my 6weeks progress on the app and I can’t log back into my fist Google account . And I have days (Monday,tuesday, Thursday, Friday) that I work out and (Wednesday,Saturday,and Sunday that I don’t work out)and when I log into another Google account it says yesterday (Monday )  I didn’t do/ complete any exercises and the app keep trying to give me a tutorial of the app like I haven’t used it before and keep taking my progress away and when I try to get on my first original account that I first used to track my progress on the app that paid for a subscription it just keeps saying loading .

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: I love the Military Calisthenics workout. My second day I was sore, but I know the workout is for my good. I am not getting any younger and I have to stay in shape. Also, I can do this workout in the privacy of my home.
